Dolma dog rescue is dedicated to build awareness towards compassion for animals in need of shelter and medical care. Founded in Tibetan refugee settlement Bylakuppe South India. 
The rescue house operates with few staffs and one veterinarian. It is managed by Dolma and Kalsang. At rescue house, dogs and cats are brought in by kind locals who wish to see them heal from life threatening injuries. Injured animals are brought here for another chance of life. The rescue house was started in order to give comfort and love to the neglected and injured animals. 
Dolma believes in  caring for them and hope to build a sustainable facility.
